title: Iran live updates: VP heads to Switzerland for talks amid opposing claims on strait
description: President Donald Trump announced "major combat operations" against Iran on Feb. 28, with massive joint U.S.-Israeli strikes.

title: Luxury Kushner Project Collides With Albanian Discontent
description: Protests in Albania against plans for a luxury tourist site have become a cause célèbre for opponents of President Trump and his family. But the politics are local.

title: Voces del Mundial: Curazao hace historia y Ecuador se aferra a la clasificación
description: Curazao celebró su primer punto mundialista con el empate, valorado por Dick Advocaat. Enner Valencia y Hernán Galíndez, desde Ecuador, expresaron frustración pero mantienen la esperanza de avanzar.

title: US-Iran talks to begin in Switzerland as Tehran says it closed Strait of Hormuz
description: The US disputed Iran's claim the waterway is shut, a move Tehran says was a response to Israeli attacks in Lebanon.

title: LA emergency declaration issued for Boyle Heights warehouse fire as blaze continues
description: Firefighters faced renewed challenges Saturday at a large Boyle Heights warehouse fire, where conditions remain highly complex as Mayor Karen Bass declared a local emergency to support response efforts.

title: Mideast Live Updates: New Round of U.S.-Iran Talks Set to Start in Switzerland
description: Vice President JD Vance was expected to meet with Iranian negotiators on Sunday. Pakistan, an intermediary in the talks, said it was sending a delegation.

title: Beccacece: "Cuando se genera superioridad, un resultado así deja dudas"
description: Sebastián Beccacece explicó que, pese a la superioridad mostrada por Ecuador ante Curazao, el empate genera dudas por el resultado no esperado. El técnico destacó el rendimiento del equipo y ya piensa en el duelo decisivo ante Alemania.

title: Kamada define de taco y adelanta a Japón en Monterrey
description: Al minuto 4, Daichi Kamada abrió el marcador para Japón tras una gran jugada de Nakamura, quien controló, amagó y envió un centro preciso para que el número 15 definiera de taco ante Túnez.

title: Florida man tries to steal medical helicopter at scene of car crash he reportedly caused
description: A deranged Florida man who believes he saw the anti-Christ is accused of trying to steal a medical helicopter at the scene of a car crash he reportedly caused.
